modulePeopleCrews.name: Module: people and crews
modulePeopleCrews.summary: Turns built-in roles, the clearance checklist, leave requests and crew loans on or off for everyone.

moduleSiteDay.name: Module: site day
moduleSiteDay.summary: Turns daily safety records and the work order performance panels on or off for everyone.

moduleStock.name: Module: stock
moduleStock.summary: Turns work-order transfers, reservations, two-step transfers and the material request approvals inbox on or off for everyone.

modulePurchasingExtras.name: Module: purchasing extras
modulePurchasingExtras.summary: Turns line planning, purchase types, payment channels, purchase order print and delivery notes on or off for everyone.

moduleBillingExtras.name: Module: billing extras
moduleBillingExtras.summary: Turns revenue per discipline, the revenue plan, idle time as cost and the done-not-claimed reminder on or off for everyone.

crewLoans.name: Crew loans
crewLoans.summary: Lets a crew lend a worker to another crew for a period, shown on the Crews page.

builtInRoles.name: Built-in roles
builtInRoles.summary: Offers 28 ready-made roles when you edit a person's role. Nothing changes until someone is given one.

clearance.name: Cleared-for-site checklist
clearance.summary: Adds a Clearance section where you record what each person needs before going to site.

leaveRequests.name: Leave requests
leaveRequests.summary: Lets people request leave and names the role that approves it.

phoneCheckIn.name: Phone check-in supervisor
phoneCheckIn.summary: Chooses the role that decides phone check-ins from outside the work area.

attendanceTarget.name: Attendance target
attendanceTarget.summary: Sets the attendance rate crews are measured against.

crewTools.name: Crew tool reports
crewTools.summary: Sets the coordinator and the days a tool report may stay open.

safetyRecords.name: Daily safety records
safetyRecords.summary: Adds a daily safety record to each work order, with your own check, permit and checklist lists.

performanceIndices.name: Performance indices
performanceIndices.summary: Shows a performance panel on work orders and sets the bands it uses.

revenuePlan.name: Revenue plan
revenuePlan.summary: Spreads each month's plan over working days to give daily targets.

issueClosingReport.name: Issue closing report
issueClosingReport.summary: Adds the issue closing time report and sets how it groups issues.

quantityChangeLimit.name: Quantity change limit
quantityChangeLimit.summary: Sets how far a quantity may rise over the contract before a change request is needed.

stockTransfers.name: Stock transfers and proof
stockTransfers.summary: Chooses one-step or two-step transfers, when proof is attached, and whether issues need a signed handover too.

stockWoTransfers.name: Work-order transfers
stockWoTransfers.summary: Lets stock keepers move leftover material between work orders of one project.

stockReservations.name: Stock reservations
stockReservations.summary: Lets material be held for a work order, with optional borrowing from another reservation.

dsrStockIssue.name: Site reports post stock
dsrStockIssue.summary: Makes a submitted site report issue the material it used from stock.

woIssueThreshold.name: Material progress warning
woIssueThreshold.summary: Warns when material issued runs ahead of work progress by more than a set percentage.

purchaseTypes.name: Purchase types
purchaseTypes.summary: Lets each purchase carry a type such as rental, with your own list of types.

purchaseLinePlanning.name: Purchase line planning
purchaseLinePlanning.summary: Lets purchase lines be planned against categories before they are ordered.

threeWayMatch.name: Three-way match
threeWayMatch.summary: Holds a vendor bill until it agrees with the order and the receipt, within your tolerances.

purchaseOrderPrint.name: Purchase order print
purchaseOrderPrint.summary: Adds a printable purchase order with your signature blocks and authorised collectors.

paymentChannels.name: Payment channels
paymentChannels.summary: Records how each purchase is to be paid, from your list of channels.

spendApprovalTiers.name: Spend approval tiers
spendApprovalTiers.summary: Routes a purchase to approvers by amount instead of a single approver list.

hidePrices.name: Hide prices from requesters
hidePrices.summary: Hides prices from people who only request material.

materialRequests.name: Material request settings
materialRequests.summary: Sets the approval chain, stand-ins, delivery notes and the approver inbox.

procurementGates.name: Procurement gates
procurementGates.summary: Chooses which steps a purchase must pass before it can move on.

billingPlan.name: Billing plan
billingPlan.summary: Sets the monthly billing target, its currency and the reminder for work done but not claimed.

billingSteps.name: Billing steps
billingSteps.summary: Chooses the default list of billing steps for a work order and who each step belongs to.

labourCost.name: Labour cost
labourCost.summary: Costs hours worked at your labour class rates.

idleCost.name: Idle hours as cost
idleCost.summary: Counts idle hours as cost against the work order. Needs labour cost on.

disciplineProfit.name: Revenue per discipline
disciplineProfit.summary: Shows revenue next to cost for each discipline on a project.

equipmentPlan.name: Monthly equipment plan
equipmentPlan.summary: Adds a monthly equipment plan and sets who approves it.

equipmentTargets.name: Equipment targets
equipmentTargets.summary: Sets the availability and use targets and when a down machine is escalated.

emailNotifications.name: Email notifications
emailNotifications.summary: Chooses which events send email, to whom besides the people involved, and in which language.

scheduledReports.name: Scheduled reports
scheduledReports.summary: Emails a report to chosen people on a schedule.

m365DefaultLibrary.name: Default document library
m365DefaultLibrary.summary: Chooses the Microsoft 365 library new project folders are created in.

feedbackSurveys.name: Feedback surveys
feedbackSurveys.summary: Asks people short in-app feedback questions.

stockIssueCost.name: Stock issue costing
stockIssueCost.summary: Counts issued stock as work-order cost from a chosen date.

orderReceiving.name: Receive against order
orderReceiving.summary: Records counted goods against sent purchase orders.

managementViews.name: Management views
managementViews.summary: Shows the project portfolio and progress not yet accepted by the client.

orderNeededBy.name: Order needed-by date
orderNeededBy.summary: Requires a needed-by date before an order is sent to the supplier.

setupWorkflows.name: Setup workflows
setupWorkflows.summary: Enables work-order imports and the opening balances overview.
